mentions.name: Cross-platform multi-agent harness
mentions.description: A multi-agent harness that works across desktop and mobile, designed to manage the problem of having too many simultaneous agent sessions. It is planned to be open sourced and the builder is looking for beta testers.
mentions.problem: Drowning in too many agent sessions.
mentions.source_excerpt: As a side project I‘m building a multi agent harness that works across desktop and mobile and solves the issue of drowning in too many agent sessions for my own workflow. Hopefully I’ll open source it soon.
